headline: Congress would bar data centers on Federal land
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Congress would bar the construction of data centers on Federal land. Not passed.

123 measures in 33 jurisdictions would pause data centers, or add conditions on building and running them.

11 measures in seven jurisdictions cite the fear that AI makes it easy to spread what is not true.

2,249 measures tracked. 757 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 100 offices.
